bootstrap_selection.unit: The complete three-worker layer-2 cohort from the frozen DeepSeek raw-append run.
bootstrap_selection.selection_rule: All three outputs are included because all three self-reported successful completion. No source is selected or excluded using its external score.
bootstrap_selection.claim_boundary: The cohort was chosen after the depth-10 audit and is therefore a mechanism stress probe. Any positive direction must be reproduced prospectively before manuscript-level causal claims.

assimilation_semantics.initial_manager_state: Before worker layer 1, the manager synthesizes one shared playbook from the complete blinded bootstrap cohort.
assimilation_semantics.layer_admission: After every non-terminal layer, every output whose trajectory self-reports success is converted to a blinded proxy regardless of external benchmark score.
assimilation_semantics.manager_update: The manager recursively revises the previous shared playbook using the current self-report-accepted proxies.
assimilation_semantics.broadcast: Every worker in the next layer receives exactly one latest manager playbook.
assimilation_semantics.external_score_blinding: Neither manager prompts nor downstream worker prompts contain source external Core or all-test scores.

validity_gates.bootstrap_activation: The initial manager synthesis must consume all three bootstrap self-report proxies.
validity_gates.recursive_continuity: Every manager update after layer 1 must include the immediately previous manager artifact.
validity_gates.self_report_activation: At least two outputs per non-terminal layer must be admitted; otherwise the layer is diagnostic but cannot support feedback-amplification interpretation.
validity_gates.target_consistency: Every worker evaluation must use Core total 4, 37 collected tests, and the frozen collection hash.
validity_gates.score_blinding: Manager and worker prompts must not contain source external scores or Core-verification labels for self-report proxies.
validity_gates.integrity: No model-query failures, unresolved infrastructure failures, or prohibited benchmark-path actions.

probe_direction_criteria.terminal: Layer-5 mean all-test score is below 0.75 or at least one layer-5 worker scores 0/37.
probe_direction_criteria.within_arm: Layer-5 mean all-test score is at least 0.15 below the best earlier layer.
probe_direction_criteria.curve_shape: At least two post-bootstrap transitions decrease, or one transition decreases by at least 0.25.
probe_direction_criteria.feedback_trace: A manager playbook retains or strengthens a claim originating in an externally failed but self-report-accepted source, and a later worker follows that claim.
probe_direction_criteria.go: If terminal plus either within-arm or curve-shape passes with all validity gates, freeze and run no-transfer and raw-append controls plus three prospective repeats.
probe_direction_criteria.no_go: If the arm reaches a stable fixed point without terminal degradation, stop extending this exact probe and move to a task with a continuous robustness/cost metric.
